hero.title: One trusted match feed. Every audience, every language.
hero.description: MatchIQ spots the moments that matter as the match plays. The stats come straight from the match data, AI explains why each moment matters, a fact check confirms every number, and producers get on-air graphics they can trust and pull at any time.
hero.disclosure: The demo uses fictional, simulated matches. No real clubs, players or league marks.
facts: to take any graphic off air

pipeline.title: Five steps from the pitch to the screen
pipeline.description: Every fact is worked out once from the match data. Nothing changes them afterwards, and a fact check confirms each number before it airs.

ingest.title: Collect
ingest.description: Every pass, shot and tackle is recorded once, in order, with its source.

interpret.title: Understand
interpret.description: Live score, possession, momentum and other stats, worked out the same way every time.

explain.title: Explain
explain.description: AI analyst, writer and fact checker turn key moments into words, each tied to the plays behind it.

render.title: Show
render.description: On-air graphics timed to the match, kept inside safe areas, and removable in one click.

personalize.title: Personalise
personalize.description: Versions for fans, analysts and broadcast, in English, French, Spanish and Nigerian Pidgin, from the same facts.

principles.title: Built to be trusted on air

evidence.title: Every number is checked
evidence.description: Each number on screen links back to the plays and the stat behind it. If a number cannot be checked, it does not go on air.

repeatable.title: Same match, same numbers
repeatable.description: Stats come from fixed, tested rules. Replay a match and you get exactly the same figures every time.

resilience.title: Keeps going if the writer fails
resilience.description: Scores and stats never depend on the writing. If it is slow or wrong, standard wording goes on air, and a producer can pull any graphic at any time.

guide.title: A three-minute tour
guide.description: Eight short steps that show the best of MatchIQ. Every match here is simulated, and nothing needs setting up first.
guide.wording: Commentary is written by a model when one is available or replayed from a recording. Otherwise standard wording is used, and either way a fact check confirms every number first.

start.title: Start a replay
start.doThis: Open the matches, pick Late comeback and start the replay at a fast speed.
start.shows: A whole match plays out in a few minutes, the same way every time.

watch.title: Watch it build
watch.doThis: Stay in the Live studio and watch the key moments, the match stats and the on-air preview.
watch.shows: Each key moment is spotted in the match data, written up, fact-checked and timed for broadcast.

evidence.title: Open the evidence
evidence.doThis: Press Evidence on a key moment. Switch the audience to Analyst to see the Compared with block.
evidence.shows: The plays and stats behind the moment, and how it compares with the rest of the match.

audience.title: Change audience and language
audience.doThis: Switch the audience, then choose a commentary language, including Naijá (Pidgin).
audience.shows: The wording changes for each audience and language while the facts and figures stay identical.

listen.title: Listen to a moment
listen.doThis: Press Listen on a key moment.
listen.shows: The moment is read aloud with the voice on your own device. Nothing is sent anywhere to make the audio.

factchecks.title: See the fact checks
factchecks.doThis: Back in the matches, open your replay and choose Fact-checks at the top.
factchecks.shows: Who wrote each moment, and which wrong facts or numbers the fact check stopped before anything went on air.

producer.title: Try the producer view
producer.doThis: Sign in as the demo producer, switch publishing to Manual and press Send to air on a waiting graphic. Then open the Activity log.
producer.shows: A producer approves each graphic before it airs, and every action is recorded in a log that cannot be edited.

recap.title: Get the recap
recap.doThis: At full time, open the recap from the matches and choose Download match report.
recap.shows: The result, the key moments and the final stats in one readable report you can keep.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.description: Live match updates need an internet connection. Reconnect, then try again. We don't show saved copies, so what you see is always current.

auth.title: Sign in to MatchIQ
auth.lead: Use your organisation account. What you can do depends on your role.
auth.unavailable: Sign-in isn't set up here. You can still use the public demo without signing in.
auth.publicDemo: Browse the demo without signing in

errors.callback: Sign-in didn't finish. Please try again.
errors.unavailable: We can't reach the sign-in service right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.expired: You've been signed out for security. Sign in again to carry on where you left off.

lobby.title: Choose a match to replay
lobby.description: Pick a match and a speed. Key moments, stats and on-air graphics build as it plays.

howItWorks.label: How replays work
howItWorks.text: Each match plays out the same way every time, so you can rehearse and compare. Anyone with the link to a replay sees the same moment you do.

1.label: Real time
1.description: A full match takes about 90 minutes.

5.label: Brisk
5.description: About 18 minutes. Good for a guided walkthrough.

20.label: Fast
20.description: About 5 minutes. Key moments arrive close together.

30.label: Highlights
30.description: About 3 minutes. Best for a quick demo.

lobby.rateLimited: You've started a lot of replays in a short time. Wait a minute, or join one of the recent replays below.

empty.title: No matches to replay yet
empty.description: Matches appear here as soon as they are ready. Check back in a moment.

scenarioPreviews.comeback: The visitors build a lead before the break. Watch for a late turnaround.
scenarioPreviews.disallowed-goal: A goal is chalked off after it goes in. Watch it come off the screen.
scenarioPreviews.high-press: Both sides press hard. Expect tackles, turnovers and quick breaks.
scenarioPreviews.low-event: A cagey, slow match with few shots. Useful for quiet spells on air.
scenarioPreviews.possession-dominance: One side keeps the ball and the territory. Watch the pressure build.
scenarioPreviews.red-card-swing: A sending-off changes the game. Watch the momentum shift.
